newsitem.title: USA: Advantage Life sets acquisition, changes.
newsitem.headline: Advantage Life sets acquisition, changes.

text.p: Advantage Life Products Inc said Wednesday it agreed to acquire Treasure Rockhound Ranches Inc from Channel America Broadcasting Inc for six million Advantage restricted common shares, a note for $750,000 and the assumption of liabilities totaling about $658,000.
Previously, according to Standard & Poor's Marketscope, Advantage had nearly 1.6 million shares outstanding.
In conjunction with this agreement, the company said in a statement, Richard J. Diamond and Donald R. Mastropietro have been elected to Advantage's board.
All the former directors and officers of Advantage resigned in conjunction with this transaction.
Diamond was named chairman, president and chief executive officer, and Mastropietro was named treasurer, secretary, vice president of finance and chief financial officer, it said.
The statement included no identification of Diamond and Mastropietro, and company officials were not available to provide this information.
The company said Treasure Rockhound, which does business as "Camper Ranch Club of America", owns and operates six RV parks and campgrounds in Texas, New Mexico and Arizona.
Advantage said it intends to immediately begin raising five million dollars in equity funding to purchase additional RV parks and campgrounds beginning in 1997.
It is also Advantage's intention to hold a shareholder's meeting to change its name to Advantage Recreational Resorts, Inc to better reflect the new business of the company.
The company also said its corporate offices of Advantage have relocated to Camper Ranche Club's offices in Lakeland, Fla. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
